title: Comparative Value Proof Pilot
purpose: Compare native tooling, Runtime Intelligence minimal adoption, and one bounded targeted-instrumentation step without presuming Runtime Intelligence wins.
importantLimit: This pilot uses existing real-behavior fault labs so it validates the study protocol and product value signals, not external generalization. A promising pilot must be followed by a non-lab/real-consumer or independent-developer study.

measurementContract.timerStart: Immediately before triggering the fault from a clean/reset state.
measurementContract.timeToRelevantSourceStop: When the participant can name the application file/boundary they would inspect next and record why.
measurementContract.timeToActionableDiagnosisStop: When the participant can state a concrete code change or bounded next investigation; stop as not-reached when that never occurs.

decisionGate.criticalTrustRule: Any trust violation is a product defect and cannot be offset by speed.
decisionGate.continueSignal: Proceed to proof-driven fixes/independent validation only if the pilot shows repeated concrete advantage on difficult cases without unacceptable false positives or instrumentation cost.
decisionGate.stopOrNarrowSignal: If native tooling is preferred on most cases, RI adds steps without unique evidence/verification value, or useful Level 0/targeted outcomes remain below roughly half the corpus, narrow or simplify before expansion.

faults.title: Sequential API waterfall from a plain service path
faults.trigger: In the Sequential API waterfall card, click Open order workspace once.
faults.symptom: The workflow loads order, customer and pricing through visibly sequential requests.
faults.targetedLimit: At most one React ownership boundary OR one targeted operation instrument; do not modify the service behavior.

faults.title: Stale async result overwrites a newer result
faults.trigger: In the Stale async race card, click Run stale-result race once and wait for both requests.
faults.symptom: The newer fast result appears first, then the older slow result incorrectly overwrites it.
faults.targetedLimit: At most one targeted React state/effect/ownership instrument; do not fix the race before scoring.

faults.title: Large response followed by expensive main-thread report processing
faults.trigger: In the Large response + main-thread processing card, click Generate heavy report once.
faults.symptom: A report request completes and is followed by synchronous work that blocks the main thread for roughly 135 ms.
faults.targetedLimit: At most one ownership/profiling boundary around the report path; no worker conversion before scoring.

faults.title: Controlled Vue component render error
faults.trigger: Click the controlled Vue component error action once.
faults.symptom: A component render path throws and the app-level Vue error handling path receives the failure.
faults.targetedLimit: Use app-level install first; targeted mode may add only one bounded component/domain evidence step.

faults.title: Bounded reactive feedback loop
faults.trigger: Click Run bounded reactive feedback loop once and let it settle.
faults.symptom: A watcher/microtask chain repeatedly changes reactive state before stopping.
faults.targetedLimit: At most one app/domain evidence extension; no blanket component instrumentation.

faults.title: Eight updates in a short burst
faults.trigger: Click Run 8 updates / ~80 ms once and let the burst finish.
faults.symptom: A component performs eight updates in about 80 ms.
faults.targetedLimit: No more than one explicit budget/ownership configuration change; do not tune thresholds until after scoring.

faults.title: Lit HTTP 503 with invocation provenance
faults.trigger: Click HTTP 503 once and wait for the request to complete.
faults.symptom: An application fetch returns an intentional HTTP 503.
faults.targetedLimit: Use the shared instrumented Lit base as the minimal baseline; targeted mode may add one bounded operation/source instrument.

faults.title: Runtime error with an existing fix-toggle verification path
faults.trigger: With Fixed error mode OFF, click Intentional Error once. For verification scoring, use the existing fixed-mode toggle only after the baseline is captured.
faults.symptom: An async runtime error is emitted; the lab already provides an explicit fixed-mode replay path.
faults.targetedLimit: Do not add a custom metric unless the automatic finding-verification plan is honestly unsupported.

faults.title: Unremoved resize listener without governed resource ownership
faults.trigger: Click Leak Resize Listener twice, then reproduce a resize.
faults.symptom: Resize listeners retain captured arrays and are intentionally never removed.
faults.targetedLimit: Targeted mode may add one explicit governed resource registration/release instrument; no global monkey patch.
